title: DuckDBConfig
description: Configuration for DuckDB integration loaded from environment variables

enabled.description: Whether DuckDB integration is enabled. Controlled by GX_DUCKDB_ENABLED environment variable.

size_threshold_mb.description: File size threshold in MB above which DuckDB is automatically used. Controlled by GX_DUCKDB_SIZE_THRESHOLD_MB environment variable.

memory_limit.description: DuckDB memory limit (e.g., '4GB', '512MB'). Controlled by GX_DUCKDB_MEMORY_LIMIT environment variable. Null means use DuckDB default.

temp_directory.description: Directory for DuckDB temporary/spill files. Controlled by GX_DUCKDB_TEMP_DIR environment variable. Null means use system temp directory.
